ModMetaData.name: Rebalanced Ancient Junk
ModMetaData.author: dickmosi
ModMetaData.description:
A mod that aims to improve the consistency and logic of ancient junk. By making changes to cover effectiveness and steel slag yield.
Ancient Junk can now spawn partially damaged too!
Changelog: Recent changes can be found on the Workshop page 'Change Notes' (Found underneath the mod's thumbnail.)
